title: No more connection when ending Nano (and DASH) pods
symptom: After deactivating a Nano or DASH pod, an alert 'pod basal injection' or 'pump unreachable/basal not set' appears, and the pump becomes unreachable. The issue occurs systematically after each pod deactivation and also during activation of a new pod.
cause: The issue was traced to a specific commit (874ea86) that introduced changes causing the pump to be in an incorrect state during pod deactivation/activation, leading to the alert. The problem was fixed by a later commit (b92d228a).
fix: The fix was implemented in commit b92d228a, which resolved the problem for both DASH and Medtrum Nano pods. Users confirmed that after applying this commit, the alert no longer appears after deactivation.
evidence_quote: Tested commit #b92d228a: fixes the problem for DASH.
